```{r}
# Assuming your dataframe is named 'dataset'

# Create a mapping list for the positions
position_map <- list(
  "QB" = "QB",
  "RB" = "RB",
  "WO" = "WR", # Wide Out, similar to WR
  "TE" = "TE",
  "FB" = "RB", # Fullback
  "WR" = "WR",
  "OL" = "OL",
  "OT" = "OL", # Offensive Tackle
  "OG" = "OL", # Offensive Guard
  "OC" = "OL", # Offensive Center
  "C"  = "OL",  # Center (often used interchangeably with OC)
  "DL" = "DL",
  "DT" = "DL", # Defensive Tackle
  "DE" = "EDGE", # Defensive End
  "NT" = "DL", # Nose Tackle
  "EDGE" = "EDGE", # EDGE rushers are often grouped with DL or sometimes LB depending on scheme
  "LB" = "LB",
  "ILB" = "LB", # Inside Linebacker
  "OLB" = "EDGE", # Outside Linebacker
  "DB" = "DB",
  "CB" = "DB", # Cornerback
  "FS" = "DB", # Free Safety
  "SS" = "DB"  # Strong Safety
)

# Create the new column by mapping the existing positions
# We'll use a function to apply the mapping.
# If a position isn't in our map (which shouldn't happen with your list),
# it will result in NA. You can add handling for this if necessary.
dataset$Position_Group <- sapply(dataset$Position.x, function(pos) {
  # Find which group the current position belongs to
  new_pos <- position_map[[pos]]
  # If a position is not found in the map (it's NULL), you might want to keep the original or assign a default
  if (is.null(new_pos)) {
    return(NA) # Or return(pos) to keep the original if not mapped
  }
  return(new_pos)
})

# Verify the new unique position groups
print(unique(dataset$Position_Group))

# You can also see a frequency table of the new groups
print(table(dataset$Position_Group))

# And a table of the original vs new groups to check the mapping
print(table(Original = dataset$Position.x, New = dataset$Position_Group))
```




```{r}
dataset <- dataset %>% select(-c(Name,Source_File,Link,SPARQ,Power_Throw,Position.x,Position.y,Converted_Broad,Converted_Vertical,Converted_Height))
```


```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)

data_imputed <- dataset %>%
  filter(Position_Group %in% c("OL", "DL")) %>%
  group_by(Position_Group) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !Weight.x, ~ifelse(is.na(.x), mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create recipe (excluding unnecessary columns like Name, Link)
impute_recipe <- recipe(Weight.x ~ ., data = data_imputed) %>% # Exclude non-predictive variables
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_rm(Shuttle20, Vertical,Dash40)

# Define the linear regression model
lm_model <- linear_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("lm")

# Workflow creation and fitting
lm_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(impute_recipe) %>%
  add_model(lm_model)

# Fit the model
lm_fit <- lm_workflow %>% fit(data_imputed)

# View results
tidy(lm_fit) %>% print(n = Inf)
glance(lm_fit)

```



```{r}
library(patchwork)
predictions <- augment(lm_fit, data_imputed)

# Plot residuals by Position_Group
ggplot(predictions, aes(x = Position_Group, y = .resid)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(title = "Residuals by Position Group", x = "Position Group", y = "Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot observed vs predicted values
ggplot(predictions, aes(x = .pred, y = Weight.x)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Observed vs Predicted Values", x = "Predicted Weight", y = "Observed Weight") +
  theme_minimal()

```



```{r}
resid_density_plots <- predictions %>%
  filter(!is.na(Position_Group)) %>%
  split(.$Position_Group) %>%
  map(~ggplot(.x, aes(x = .resid)) +
        geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
        labs(title = unique(.x$Position_Group), x = "Residuals", y = "Density") +
        theme_minimal())

walk(resid_density_plots, print)
# Arrange plots in 3x3 grid
wrap_plots(resid_density_plots) + plot_layout(ncol = 2)
```

  Height = 73,
  Weight.y = 224,
  Dash40 = 4.8,
  Shuttle20 = 4.5,

)

predict(lm_fit,input)
